questions.question: The curved surface area of a right circular cylinder of height 28 cm is 176 cm². The volume(in cm³ ) of cylinder is (Take π = 22/7 )
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height of cylinder h = 28 cm

curved surface area = 176 cm²

Formula used:

Right circular cylinder of radius=r and height=h

⇒ Volume = πr²h

⇒ L.S.A = 2πrh

Calculation:

⇒ 176 = 2 × 3.14 × r × 28

⇒ r = 176/(2 × 28 × 3.14)

⇒ r = 1 cm

Volume of cylinder = 3.14 × 1 × 1 × 28

⇒ 88 cm3.

**∴ The Answer is 88 cm³.**

questions.question: A boat can cover 36 km downstream and 16 km upstream in 10 hours. It can cover 3 km downstream and 1.2 km upstream in 48 minutes. What is the speed (in km/hr) of the boat when going upstream?
questions.solution:
**Given**:

Distance covered by boat in upstream = 16 km

Distance covered by boat in downstream = 36 km

Time = 10 hours

**Formula used:**

Time = distance/speed

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of stream be "s" km/h

Let the speed of boat be "b" km/h

Upstream speed = (b – s)km/h

Downstream speed = (b + s)km/h

According to question:

⇒ 36/(b + s) + 16/(b - s) = 10 ----(1)

⇒ 3/(b + s) + 1.2/(b - s) = 4/5 ----(2)

Solving equation (1) and (2) simultaneously, we get

s = 1 km/hr, and b = 5 km/hr

∴ Upstream speed = (5 – 1)km/hr = 4 km/hr

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

According to question:

⇒ 36/(b + s) + 16/(b - s) = 10 ----(1)

⇒ 3/(b + s) + 1.2/(b - s) = 4/5 ----(2)

We take the direct option 4

b - s = 4 km/hr 

Put b - s = 4 kmph in the equation 1 

36/(b + s) + 16/4 = 10

⇒ 36/(b + s) + 4 = 10

⇒ b + s = 6 km/hr

Verify the second equation, Put b - s and b + s in equation 2

⇒ 3/6 + 1.2/4 = 4/5

⇒ 1/2 + 3/10 = 4/5

⇒ 8/10 = 4/5

⇒ 4/5 = 4/5 

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer**

questions.question: A person sells a watch at a profit of 26%. If he had bought it at 20% less and sold for ₹81.60 less, he would have gained 32%. What is the original cost price (in ₹) of the watch?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

 

Profit = 26%

New selling Price = ₹81.60

New Profit = 32%

**FORMULAE USED:**

Selling price = (cost price)/100 × (100 + profit%) 

**CALCULATION:**

Let the Cost price be "x"

Selling Price = 1.26x

New Cost Price = 0.8x

New Selling Price = 1.26x - 81.60

1.26x - 81.60 = (0.8x)/100 × (100 + 32) 

x = 81.60/0.204

x = 400

∴ the original cost price of the watch is ₹400

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Let CP = 100

At 26% profit sells

SP = 100(100 + 26)/100

⇒ 126

If he bought 20% less Than New CP = 100(100 – 20)/100

⇒ 80

Sold for ₹81.60 less, he would have gained 32%.

⇒ 80 × (100 + 32)/100

⇒ New SP = 105.6

Difference of SP = 126 – 105.6 = 20.4

20.4 on 100

⇒ 1 → 100/20.4

⇒ 81.6 → (100/20.4)81.6

∴ CP = Rs. 400

questions.question: The average weight of a certain number of persons in a group was 75.5 kg. Later on, 4 persons weighing 72.6 kg. 74 kg, 73.4 kg and 70 kg joined the group. As a result, the average weight of all persons in the group reduced by 500 g. The number of persons in the group, initially, was:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Average weight = 75.5 kg 

Weight of new people = 72.6 kg, 74 kg, 73.4 kg and 70 kg 

New Average weight = 75 kg

**FORMULA USED:**

Total weight = Average weight × Number of persons

**CALCULATION:**

Let the initial number of People be x

Total weight initially = 75.5x

New total weight = 75.5x + 72.6 + 74 + 73.4 + 70 = 75.5x + 290

According to question

⇒ (75.5x + 290)/(x + 4) = 75

⇒ 75.5x + 290 = 75(x + 4)

⇒ 75.5x + 290 = 75x + 300

⇒ 0.5x = 10

x = 20

**∴ The number of persons in the group, initially, was 20**

questions.question: The area of an equilateral triangular park is equal to 5√3 times the area of a triangular field with sides 18 m, 80 m, and 82 m. What is the side of the triangular park?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Sides of triangular field = 18 m, 80 m and 82 m

**CONCEPT:**

area of a triangular park = 5√3 × the area of a triangular field

**FORMULAE USED:** 

Area of an equilateral triangle = (√3/4) a²

Area of triangle with sides a, b, and c = √[s(s - a)(s - b)(s - c)], where s = (a + b + c)/2

**CALCULATION:**

s = (18 + 80 + 82)/2 = 90

The area of a triangular field = √[90(90 - 18)(90 - 80)(90 - 82)] = √[90 × 72 × 10 × 8] = 720 m²

According to question,

(√3/4) a2 = 5√3 × 720

a = 120

**∴ side of the triangular park = 120 m**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**Sides of triangular field = 18 m, 80 m, and 82 m

Triplet 18² + 80² = 82²

area of right angle triangle = (1/2)Base × Height

⇒ (1/2)18 × 80

⇒ 720 m²

According to question,

(√3/4) a2 = 5√3 × 720

a = 120

**∴ side of the triangular park = 120 m**

questions.question: Let x be the greatest number such that when 12085, 16914 and 13841 are divided by it, the remainder in each case is same. The sum of digits of x is:

Find the HCF of the differences of the three numbers

13841 - 12085 = 1756

16914 - 13841 = 3073

16914 - 12085 = 4829

Calculating the HCF of 1756, 3073 and 4829

The factors of 1756 are: 1, 2, 4, **439**, 878, 1756

The factors of 3073 are: 1, 7, **439**, 3073

The factors of 4829 are: 1, 11, **439**, 4829

Then the greatest common factor is 439.

Sum of digits of HCF = 4 + 3 + 9 = 16

questions.question: The average of 41 numbers is 63. The average of first 21 number is 61.5 and that of last 21 numbers is 65.5. if 21st number is excluded then the average of remaining numbers is:
questions.solution:
GIVEN: 

Average of 41 numbers = 63

Average of first 21 numbers = 61.5

Average of last 21 numbers = 65.5

FORMULA USED:

Average = sum of observations/number of observations

CALCULATION:

Sum of 41 numbers = 41 × 63 = 2583

Sum of first 21 numbers = 61.5 × 21 = 1291.5 

Sum of last 21 numbers = 65.5 × 21 = 1375.5

21st number = 1375.5 - 1291.5 = 84

Average of numbers excluding 21st number = (2583 - 84)/40

∴ Average of numbers excluding 21st number is 62.475

questions.question: Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 12 minutes and 15 minutes, respectively. When an outlet pipe C is also opened, then the three pipes together can fill the tank in 10 minutes. In how many minutes can C alone empty the full tank?

questions.question: If the radius of a sphere is decreased by 25%, then the percentage decrease in its surface area is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Decrease in radius = 25%

**Formula used:** 

Surface area of the sphere = 4πr²

**Calculation:**

New radius = 0.75r

Surface area of the sphere = 4π(0.75r)²

Surface area of the sphere = 4π(0.5625r²)

Percentage decrease in surface area = 4πr²(1- 0.5625) × 100/4πr²

**∴ Percentage decrease in surface area = 43.75%.**

questions.question: Working together, A, B and C can complete a work in 36 days. If the efficiency of A, B and C are in the ratio 5 : 6 : 9, then B alone will complete the same work in:
questions.solution:
According to question,

Time taken by A to complete the work = x/5

Time taken by B to complete the work = x/6

Time taken by C to complete the work C = x/9

Thus, A, B and C can complete a work in 36 days.

(1/x/5) + (1/x/5) + (1/x/5) = 1/36

(5/x) + (6/x) + (9/x) = 1/36

x = 20 × 36 = 720

∴ Time Taken by B alone will be 120 days

__**Alternate solution**__

Let work done per day by A, B and C be 5 units, 6 units and 9 units respectively.

Total work = (5 + 6 + 9) × 36 = 20 × 36 = 720 units

∴ Required time taken by B = 720/6 = 120 days.
